message: Ever had one of those moments where you just knew a blackout was coming? I recently stumbled upon some solid tips for handling power outages, and let me tell you, it feels great to be a step ahead! This resource covers everything from prepping ahead to what to do when the lights go out. It’s a handy reminder that being prepared can turn a surprise into a smooth sailing experience.
